_comment: Atlas Weekly Review realistic trial watchlist. Anonymized placeholder data. Not investment advice.
name: Quality Research Watchlist

items.name: Xylem
items.reason: Water infrastructure theme with long-term demand logic from aging municipal networks. Initiation of early-stage research.
evidence_needed: Margin durability under commodity and energy cost cycles
Valuation context relative to infrastructure and industrial peers
Portfolio overlap and concentration impact if added
Capital allocation track record: dividends, acquisitions, and organic growth split
open_questions: Is revenue mix shifting toward higher-margin software and services?
How durable is replacement demand from municipal water customers over a 5-year horizon?
What is the competitive response from adjacent infrastructure technology platforms?
How does the Evoqua acquisition change the long-term revenue and margin profile?
manual_observations: No position currently. Research in early stage.
Water infrastructure spending is structural — not economically cyclical in the same way as industrial capex.
Margin durability through the 2022-2024 cost cycle has not yet been reviewed.
items.notes: Reason to wait: margin durability and valuation context require review before any further consideration. No action warranted at this stage.

items.name: Adyen
items.reason: Global payments infrastructure with enterprise focus. Monitoring recovery trajectory after 2023 deceleration.
evidence_needed: Volume growth recovery durability and churn rate evidence
Competitive positioning relative to Stripe and incumbent processors
Margin trajectory following the headcount increase cycle
Enterprise win rate and contract renewal evidence
open_questions: Is the 2023 deceleration a structural shift or a temporary digestion period?
What is the medium-term margin target and path?
How does Adyen differentiate in the North American market where competition is most intense?
manual_observations: The 2023 deceleration was a significant negative surprise relative to prior trajectory.
Recovery indicators from recent quarters are encouraging but not yet sufficient for a thesis.
items.notes: Decision deferred pending volume recovery confirmation over at least two more reporting periods. No action warranted without this evidence.

items.name: Rockwool International B
items.reason: Building insulation with strong sustainability tailwinds from energy efficiency regulation in Europe.
evidence_needed: Demand durability through current construction cycle downturn
Pricing power evidence relative to glass wool and spray foam competitors
Regulatory tailwind quantification: how binding are the European insulation mandates?
open_questions: How exposed is volume growth to new residential construction versus renovation?
Is the margin profile defensible through commodity and energy input cycles?
What is the growth opportunity outside Europe?
manual_observations: Construction downturn is creating near-term volume headwinds that may represent a research opportunity.
Family control reduces M&A risk but also limits capital allocation flexibility.
items.notes: Watchlist observation stage. No evidence review completed yet. No action warranted.

items.name: Veeva Systems
items.reason: Vertical SaaS for life sciences with high switching costs and recurring revenue. Research substantially complete.
evidence_needed: Vault platform adoption rate and account expansion penetration in existing accounts
Competitive risk from emerging vertical CRM entrants in pharma
open_questions: What is the realistic total addressable market once the CRM transition to Vault is complete?
How does the commercial CRM transition from Salesforce affect medium-term revenue?
manual_observations: No position currently. Research is substantially complete.
High net revenue retention above 120% indicates strong account expansion trajectory.
Founder involvement continues and capital allocation has been conservative and disciplined.
items.notes: Suitable for further review and potential allocation consideration. Awaiting a review of portfolio concentration before proceeding. No action warranted without concentration check.

items.name: DexCom
items.reason: Continuous glucose monitoring platform. Research paused due to evidence gaps on long-term competitive durability.
evidence_needed: Long-term competitive durability relative to Abbott FreeStyle Libre platform
Reimbursement pathway sustainability in the US and Europe
G7 platform adoption trajectory and market share stability
open_questions: Can DexCom maintain its premium positioning as Abbott improves accuracy parity?
What happens to volume if reimbursement policy changes in key markets?
manual_observations: Abbott FreeStyle Libre is a credible and growing competitive threat.
Reimbursement risk is not well-understood from available public data.
items.notes: Decision deferred. Evidence on competitive durability and reimbursement risk is insufficient for a quality assessment. No action warranted.
